entities.summary: Mac, a notable figure in the history of Vietnam, associated with Trinh-Nguyen Division (1527–1771). Preceded by Trinh-Nguyen Lords. Their legacy influenced Alexandre de Rhodes develops the Romanized Vietnamese script (quoc ngu) and Tay Son Rebellion and Reunification.
